## Progress

- [Support.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/FormalizedSources/StacksProject/Part01_Preliminaries/StacksPart01Lib/Support.lean:33) now proves finite-module support under arbitrary base change, the set equality, empty-support preservation, and a closedness consumer.
- [Basic.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/FormalizedSources/StacksProject/Part01_Preliminaries/StacksPart01Lib/Basic.lean:44) exports the new API.
- Committed as `839c8bef7c`, `adf076efd5`, and `3c34510f67`.
- `horizon check StacksPart01Lib` passed all 2,516 jobs. All four declarations use only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`; no `sorry`, `admit`, or project axioms were introduced.
- Hgraph sync reports 5,501 blueprint nodes, 288 verified Lean declarations, and 5,383 hard edges. A soft `formalizes` edge records Tag `0BUR`; the closedness consumer has a soft `related_to` edge.
- The standing task remains `running`; roadmap item `StacksPart01.localization-support` remains `pending`.

## Issues

- Tag `0BUR` remains source-empty under protection I-2034. Lean uses `B ⊗[A] M` rather than the source’s tensor ordering; the canonical symmetry bridge is not explicit, so no completion claim was made.
- The source cites local Nakayama, while Lean directly uses Mathlib’s residue-field support criterion. This boundary is recorded on the graph node.
- The generated blueprint cache remains dirty and unstaged because its concurrent rewrite would remove 499 nodes. One pre-existing dangling blueprint dependency also remains.
- A redundant direct root check was cancelled while waiting behind a long shared AJCR check; the final 2,516-job build already covered the root target.

## Why I Stopped

The objective is partly advanced, not complete. All scoped Lean changes are committed and verified, while source attachment and downstream Tag `00U2` remain open.

## Next

Add an explicit tensor-symmetry bridge or authorized source pin, then consume the support theorem in the downstream étale/localization chain.

Claim class: proved producer and proved consumer, with imported Mathlib boundary.  
Frontier before/after: Tag `0BUR` had no Lean producer; it now has a verified soft-linked producer, while exact source attachment remains unmet.  
Consumer: `support_baseChange_finite_isClosed`; intended source consumer Tag `00U2` remains empty.  
Evidence: 2,516-job build, four axiom scans, source scan, and hgraph audit. `honesty-reviewer: used`, final verdict honest and partial.
